open_questions: Frame cell layout: 0x8083e34 writes cell[7] (the next cell's word 1) for the value slot, while 0x80825d4 reads word 1 of the top cell. The literal word-index translation is kept; confirm whether the value slot is really the next cell's word 1.
Owner word of frame cells and thread cells: whether it is always an object id or sometimes a code pointer (0x8084722 and 0x8084dd0 treat values as code offsets relative to g_08397548).
Scr_GetLowerString copies lower-cased text into an 8196-byte stack buffer without a bound (0x8084a7c); the overflow behaviour is preserved, not fixed.

Names of the script-layer functions are descriptive except for the error and typed-getter family, which are inferred from strings. The type-name table g_0817d960 is not decoded, so the type-to-name mapping (type 5 float, type 6 int, type 7 frame reference, type 8 marker, type 10 handle, type 11 anim) is inferred from the checks in this chunk only.

Out-of-chunk callee signatures (fn_08xxxxxx) are guessed from call sites; return widths such as fn_0807b760 (int16) and fn_08078ee6 (uint32 used as char pointer) should be confirmed when their owning chunks are merged.
Scr_RunSetup returns a two-word result through an out pointer; the ABI for an 8-byte struct return on this target was not verified against the caller.
